        This Policy and Procedure Notice clarifies the procedure
        requirements of fire alarm applications filed under Directive
        14/75 of the Department's Memorandum of December 22, 1983.

        As per Policy and Procedure Technical Notice 23/88, any fire
        alarm application that is approved by the Fire Department, a
        construction permit is not required. The approval from the Fire
        Department is considered a permit to do the work. This
